title: Thoughts I Cannot Say Out Loud

current_concerns.primary_problems: Since my baby was born about ten weeks ago, I have been experiencing unwanted, intrusive images of her being harmed, which I find horrifying. This occurs mostly at home, especially when I am caring for her. I have been avoiding bathing her alone and checking on her frequently during the night, making it difficult to feel safe caring for her on my own.
current_concerns.goals: I want the intrusive thoughts to stop and would like to feel safe caring for my daughter on my own.
